summary: The rare-byte prefilter recorded pattern offsets only for literal bytes, even when ASCII case-insensitive matching was enabled. Opposite-case bytes retained zero offsets, causing candidate searches to start too late and miss valid matches. The fix records offsets for both cases. Reversing the offset-setting call restores the faulty behavior while preserving the regression test added by the fix. This plan has not been executed.
expected_failure: assertion failed: expected one match but found zero, with the diagnostic 'failed to find' identifying the lowercase needle and uppercase haystack
